prompt:

Generate a new text-free isolated hero assembly inspired by that reference; do not reproduce its webpage typography or UI.

Subject: one complete vertical textile loom assembly. Across the top are exactly three distinct hanging woven host pockets, each with a broad empty dark label-safe face. Genuine dimensional braided muted-gold cords exit brass eyelets in all three host pockets. The cords descend through exactly three layered horizontal sewn stage pockets/locks, each with broad empty dark label-safe faces, graphite stitching, dimensional brass eyelets and restrained brass lock hardware. All routes converge visibly into gathered matte-black fabric under tension, then terminate at one substantial lower ready-change lock plate with a broad empty dark label-safe face.

Preserve useful empty near-black margin around the silhouette. Strong readable hierarchy: three top pockets, three stacked stage pockets, gathered fabric, final plate. Lighting/mood: restrained premium workwear product photography, soft grazing light showing weave, seams, braided cord fibers, eyelet depth, and brass patina; no glow.
Color palette: near-black silk #121317, graphite stitch #4A4E57, muted drawcord gold #B79A55, tiny warm-metal highlights only.
Materials/textures: convincing woven host pockets, heavy sewn stage pockets, true textile seams, thick braided cords, dimensional punched eyelets, aged brass cord locks/hardware, gathered matte-black fabric with physical tension.
Text: none. Every pocket and plate face must remain blank, dark, and calm for later semantic DOM overlays.
Constraints: same coherent physical assembly throughout; exactly three top host pockets and exactly three layered stage pockets; all gold cords must originate at the top pockets, pass through hardware, remain physically plausible, gather into the lower fabric, and resolve at the final lock plate. Empty label-safe regions must have low texture and no crossing cord: top pocket center faces; stage pocket left-center faces; final plate center.
